review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, repository identity/base commit, exact writable scopes, task keys, readiness and evidence stages agree. The source establishes AbortError's existing wrapping and originalError-unwrapping behavior; adding cause while preserving that contract is well specified. index.js and the separately maintained index.d.ts are implementation owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts covering runtime and compile-time regression work. package.json confirms the xo && ava && tsd verification entry point. Scope membership does not require unnecessary edits to already-correct code. The supplied runtime-test excerpt is truncated, but includes the relevant constructor, unwrapping and callback-short-circuit coverage; the implementation, declaration, type-test and configuration evidence is untruncated and sufficient for this planning expectation. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY are consistent with the PRD, including implementation and verification coverage of all required acceptance criteria. Their allowed agents have active project-scoped trusted claims for the relevant API, JavaScript, TypeScript, asynchronous integration, consumer integration, failure-handling and testing capabilities; verification additionally has testing.verification. Pending data.change, domain.state and security.authorization claims are not treated as trusted or needed merely because this bounded change adds an invocation-local error-property reference. A separate configured reviewer is present should the independent-review prerequisite apply. No material unresolved DEC-001 or hypothetical C input is supplied in this case, so there is no supported decisions-stage blocker. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and trimmed versus original PRD fingerprints. Historical operations are explicitly old-bundle evidence, not fresh candidate results, and project reuse preserves the scope of existing attestations. The original specification's null releaseInput and remaining-work list describe preparation state; the frozen preview and Gold supply the subsequent release input. This approval assesses the supplied review data only: it does not attest human confirmation, authorize task execution, or claim code execution or independent digest recomputation.
